svg.metadata: {"id": "s094", "name": "雪山", "cat": "自然与地理", "tags": ["科学", "地理", "冬季运动", "气候"], "desc": "晴朗雪山：远近三层雪峰（冷蓝到淡紫），山脚冰湖倒映，雪松林与冒着炊烟的小木屋，雪花轻舞。", "stand": {"ground_y": 910, "x": [480, 1440]}, "subtitle": [0, 950, 1920, 1060], "layers": [{"name": "sky", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "clouds", "enter": "slide-l", "delay": 0.2, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "peaks_far", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.25, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "peaks_mid", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.4, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "lake", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0.45, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "lake_shine", "enter": "fade", "delay": 1.0, "loop": "flow", "depth": null}, {"name": "snow_slope", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.55, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "pines", "enter": "grow", "delay": 0.65, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "cabin", "enter": "pop", "delay": 0.8, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "cabin_glow", "enter": "fade", "delay": 1.0, "loop": "glow", "depth": null}, {"name": "smoke", "enter": "fade", "delay": 1.1, "loop": "drift", "depth": null}, {"name": "snowflakes", "enter": "fade", "delay": 1.2, "loop": "twinkle", "depth": null}], "palette": {"sky1": "#7FB7E8", "sky2": "#EAF4FD", "sun": "#FFFFFF", "far": "#C6D6F0", "far2": "#AFC2E6", "mid": "#8FA8D6", "mid2": "#7790C4", "snow": "#FFFFFF", "snow2": "#DCE8F7", "lake": "#A9D8EE", "lake2": "#E2F4FC", "pine": "#3E7C86", "pine2": "#2E6470", "trunk": "#6E5246", "cabin": "#C77B4E", "cabin2": "#9E5A36", "roof": "#FFFFFF", "win": "#FFD27A", "smoke": "#FFFFFF", "flake": "#FFFFFF"}}
